_doc: KSPCB F-register counts for the Kabini polluted stretch. Built by scripts/build_kabini_fregister.py; see that file for the three extraction traps and for why no 17-category count is published.

source.title: KSPCB F-Register 2020-21, Regional Office Mysore-2 (PDF title: 'F-Register 2020-21 updated 31.03.2021')
source.publisher: Karnataka State Pollution Control Board, Regional Office Mysore-2

seventeenCategory.reason: The register flags only five rows as '17-Cat' and encodes the subset nowhere else, so a 17-category count cannot be read from this source.

readAgainst.claim: 38 water-polluting industries, 9.03 MLD of effluent and 38 ETPs of 9.43 MLD capacity, all recorded as complying
readAgainst.source: KSPCB Kabini stretch monthly progress report, August 2025
readAgainst.note: The register is a 2021-03-31 snapshot and the MPR figure is from August 2025; the two are four years apart. On the register, Nanjangud taluk carries 71 Red-category units, 30 of them recorded as operating.
